Location: FKiSS Events > mouseout

Event: Mouseout(target)

Related Events: mousein
Related Actions: letmousex, letmousey
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

mouseout(target)

First defined in: FKiSS4
The mouseout event is triggered when the mouse passes out of the bounding rectangle for target.
Only one mouseout event should exist for any target.

target

target may be an object number, cel, or group.

Example:

;@ mouseout("this.cel") ; When the mouse cursor is no longer over "this.cel"...
;@   altmap("this.cel") ; Hide "this.cel" if visible or show if hidden.
